We have key facts. Need maybe more sources: restart policy behavior docs, `docker compose restart` docs, maybe version 2.18.0 release notes to confirm required introduced 2.20.0. Already reference says required introduced in 2.20.0. That's enough for optional telemetry cannot use required false with 2.18.0. But need verify maybe compose-spec? The current docs say support. We should fetch release notes v2.20.0 maybe and v2.17.0. Also `docker compose restart` behavior, and runtime restart propagation. The services reference already explicitly says restart excludes automated restart by runtime. Need explicit operator restarts. Startup-order says restart true ensures if db updated/restarted due to explicit Compose operation e.g. `docker compose restart`, web also restarted. So explicit compose restart yes in v2.18.0 (restart true introduced 2.17.0). But short-form depends_on currently doesn't include restart true. Need change to long syntax.

Need also migration service: depends_on migration condition service_completed_successfully. But important: if API has both db service_healthy and migration completed successfully, API starts after both. Migration service itself depends_on db service_healthy. Need restart policy for one-shot migration: "no" or on-failure? Docs: restart applies on container termination; one-shot should not restart always. Maybe no is default. But if `docker compose up` restarts/recreates db, migration won't rerun automatically; API restart: true would restart API without rerunning migration, which may be problematic. Need mention: `restart: true` on API's dependency on db restarts API but does not rerun migration; migration only completes once at startup/creation. If DB is restarted explicitly after data loss? The migration service container exits; Compose doesn't rerun it unless `docker compose up` recreates. Actually restart true on API dependency solely to db? Could add migration as dependency with restart true? But migration completed successfully; on explicit compose restart of db, migration doesn't restart automatically? `restart: true` instructs Compose restarts this service after it updates dependency service. It may restart API, but does it re-run migration? If API has depends_on migration condition service_completed_successfully and restart true, when db restarts, API restarts; migration maybe not. Need recommend an entrypoint migration/init container or run migration as part of API startup? But within Compose only, could have migration service with restart: no and use `depends_on` to ensure order on `compose up`. Yet on explicit db restart, API restarts but migration won't, so schema may be stale. More robust: run migrations through API entrypoint after db healthcheck; or invoke `docker compose run migration` manually before up; or use a one-shot service and accept no auto rerun. The question says "A one-shot migration service must finish successfully before the API starts." So condition service_completed_successfully. Documented. But need separate "successful migration completion" and lifecycle. Note: service_completed_successfully requires dependency service to run to successful completion; if migration restarts due to `restart: always`, condition only satisfied on exit 0? If it exits 0, container stops and depends_on condition satisfied. But restart policy always would restart it, making it not a one-shot. So no restart policy on migration.

Need also "developers assume same propagation whenever database crashes and container runtime restarts it" — ref says restart true excludes automated restart by runtime. So cannot rely. If DB crashes and has restart: always, runtime restarts DB, but API is not restarted by Compose. API remains running (unless its own restart policy) and might reconnect if app handles it. The configuration cannot justify promising API remains ready throughout later DB failures: depends_on conditions only evaluated at startup, no continuous health supervision or readiness coupling. `service_healthy` waits at startup only. Restart true only on explicit Compose operations. Also API's own restart: always? The proposal says database defines restart: always, not API. If API crashes? doesn't matter. But if API has no restart policy and DB failure makes API exit, Compose won't restart API. Need recommend API restart: unless-stopped or on-failure plus application-level resilience/retry and readiness probes. Also healthcheck on API could affect dependents; but telemetry? Let's cover.

Need perhaps fetch the compose restart CLI reference and the Docker run restart policy docs, or compose releases for v2.20.0. We need at least two pages; already have two distinct pages but one is same page sections? Actually startup-order and services reference are two distinct official pages. Good. But to strengthen version facts and restart behavior, fetch:
- https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/compose/restart/
- https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/container/run/#restart
Maybe also https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/tag/v2.20.0 (official first-party but GitHub). Allowed public first-party redirects; docs.docker.com links to GitHub releases. Could fetch release notes. But we have enough from reference: required introduced in Docker Compose 2.20.0; restart introduced 2.17.0. To verify plugin version 2.18.0 supports restart true but not required false. Yes.

Need maybe check compose restart CLI docs: "If you make changes to your compose.yml, these changes are not reflected after running this command." Maybe irrelevant. `docker compose restart` restarts all services, `docker compose restart SERVICE` restarts one. Does it restart dependents? The docs startup-order say yes due to restart:true only. Also `docker compose restart` doesn't consider depends_on by default? Hmm restart true is what triggers dependent restart. Good.
